nodes.label: .`AC-109 start opens an attempt at the phone step and a second session of the owner resumes it`()
.`AC-109 cancel is 204 even twice, and the attempt is then not found`()
.`AC-109 an attempt idle for 15 minutes is not found`()
.`AC-107 a phone Telegram refuses is 422 with its reason and the attempt stays at the phone step`()
.`AC-02 a wrong or expired code is 422 and the attempt stays, a new code can be asked`()
.`AC-02 a Telegram wait is 429 with retryAt and Retry-After and ends the attempt`()
.`AC-106 a wrong password is 422 with the hint, the right one links the account`()
.`a step at the wrong place is 409 linking-step-mismatch naming the current step`()
.`steps without an open attempt are 404 linking-attempt-not-found`()
.`AC-107 a phone of only whitespace is 422 telegram-phone-invalid and the attempt stays`()
.`AC-107 an unregistered number found at the code step is 422 and the attempt has ended`()
.`AC-107 a phone refused on resend is 422 and the attempt has ended`()
.`AC-107 an unregistered number with no replacement session is 422 and the attempt has ended`()
.`a start Telegram does not answer is 503 telegram-unavailable and opens no attempt`()
.`invalid bodies are 400 validation-failed naming the field`()
.`signing in again for an account that is not the owner's is 404 not-found`()
.`AC-115 starting at the limit is 409 linked-account-limit-reached with the limit`()
.`AC-115 an account that took the last place during the attempt is 409 with the limit and is logged out`()
.`AC-117 signing in again for an account that is not Session lost is 409 telegram-account-already-linked`()
.`AC-108 the same account again after authorization is 409 telegram-account-already-linked and logged out`()
.`AC-04 an account of another Owner is 409 telegram-account-owned-by-another-owner and logged out`()
.`AC-117 signing in to a different Telegram account is 409 telegram-account-mismatch and logged out`()
.`AC-117 signing in again as the same account answers signed-in-again with the same id`()
.`a password step that completes into a refusal is 409 as well`()
.`no phone, code or password reaches the log`()
